dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: There are, but perhaps not right now.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: There are some beautiful forests in Nod-Krai that rarely see visitors, so I like to go to such places and rest when I am free.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's because of the extraordinary blood that flows through my veins... I am always concerned with matters such as the cleanliness of the water and the gentleness of the breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: And that is also why I have less time to truly relax compared to others.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Only in places such as those can I truly forget my frustrations. Soaking in the water and daydreaming... Why, sometimes I lose focus, and slip into my six-limbed form...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Six limbs? That would be a rare sight indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe, indeed. Life is easier with more limbs to work with...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ah, do forgive me. We seem to have talked ourselves onto a rather unorthodox tangent.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Is that so? What a relief.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: It truly pays to befriend those who have seen much of the world.

choices.text: Does it feel weird to have six limbs?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: No, I'm used to it by now. Besides, sprinting with four legs simply means an advantage in speed. Once you experience it, it's hard to go back to anything else.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No wonder you sometimes just forge ahead without looking back...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Yes, it is as you say. I have made quite the habit out of sprinting around.
